attrs.title: Build pages without leaving the browser
attrs.description: Drag a section in, edit the copy in place, publish when it reads right.

attrs.title: Every component is yours to change
attrs.description: Colours, spacing and rounding are attributes, not a theme you have to fork.

attrs.title: Ship one page to every site
attrs.description: Write it once as a global component and reuse it across each site you run.

examples.label: Homepage hero carousel that plays through three headlines
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-carousel" site="Global" id="showcase-carousel-hero" indicator={true} autoplay={true} autoplay_interval={6000} overlay="dark" size="large" padding="large">
  <:slide
    image="/images/card-1.jpg"
    title="Build pages without leaving the browser"
    description="Drag a section in, edit the copy in place, publish when it reads right."
    content_position="center"
  />
  <:slide
    image="/images/card-2.jpg"
    title="Every component is yours to change"
    description="Colours, spacing and rounding are attributes, not a theme you have to fork."
    content_position="center"
  />
  <:slide
    image="/images/card-3.jpg"
    title="Ship one page to every site you run"
    description="Write it once as a global component and reuse it wherever it belongs."
    content_position="center"
  />
</.component>

examples.label: Product photo gallery with four shots
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-carousel" site="Global" id="showcase-carousel-product" indicator={true} size="medium" class="max-w-xl rounded-lg">
  <:slide image="/images/card-2.jpg" />
  <:slide image="/images/card-3.jpg" />
  <:slide image="/images/card-4.jpg" />
  <:slide image="/images/card-5.jpg" />
</.component>

examples.label: Case study slider with captions along the bottom left
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-carousel" site="Global" id="showcase-carousel-cases" indicator={true} text_position="start" overlay="primary" size="medium" padding="large" class="max-w-3xl">
  <:slide
    image="/images/card-4.jpg"
    title="Kavir Logistics"
    description="Cut publishing time from two days to twenty minutes across eleven regional sites."
    content_position="end"
  />
  <:slide
    image="/images/card-5.jpg"
    title="Damavand Books"
    description="Moved 4,000 catalogue pages onto one shared layout without a single redirect."
    content_position="end"
  />
</.component>
